answer: Give every fresh identity a violet probationary badge: its votes count only after it has done costly, checkable work across several epochs, countersigned by established peers who share no invite ancestry. A falcon-sharp audit then compares timing and phrasing across accounts, so a swarm of clones ripening together is flagged as one actor. The nadir of trust is a new account with no history — weight must be earned, never minted — so cloning a thousand names buys a thousand near-zero voices.
